import openpyxl
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment, Border, Side
from openpyxl.worksheet.table import Table, TableStyleInfo

# Create the workbook and worksheet
wb = openpyxl.Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "Budget Tracker"

# Define column headers
headers = ["Category", "Budgeted Amount", "Actual Amount", "Difference"]

# Write headers with styling
for col, header in enumerate(headers, 1):
    cell = ws.cell(row=1, column=col, value=header)
    cell.font = Font(bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
    cell.fill = PatternFill(start_color="4472C4", end_color="4472C4", fill_type="solid")
    cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center", vertical="center")

# Sample categories with data
categories = [
    {"category": "Groceries", "budgeted": 400, "actual": 425},
    {"category": "Rent", "budgeted": 1200, "actual": 1200},
    {"category": "Utilities", "budgeted": 200, "actual": 185},
    {"category": "Entertainment", "budgeted": 150, "actual": 175},
]

# Write data rows
for row_index, cat_data in enumerate(categories, 2):
    ws.cell(row=row_index, column=1, value=cat_data["category"])
    ws.cell(row=row_index, column=2, value=cat_data["budgeted"])
    ws.cell(row=row_index, column=3, value=cat_data["actual"])
    ws.cell(row=row_index, column=4, value=cat_data["actual"] - cat_data["budgeted"])

# Add total row
ws.cell(row=len(categories) + 2, column=1, value="TOTAL", font=Font(bold=True))
total_budgeted = sum(cat["budgeted"] for cat in categories)
total_actual = sum(cat["actual"] for cat in categories)
total_difference = total_actual - total_budgeted

ws.cell(row=len(categories) + 2, column=2, value=total_budgeted)
ws.cell(row=len(categories) + 2, column=3, value=total_actual)
ws.cell(row=len(categories) + 2, column=4, value=total_difference)

# Add border to all cells
thin_border = Border(
    left=Side(style='thin'),
    right=Side(style='thin'),
    top=Side(style='thin'),
    bottom=Side(style='thin')
)

for row in range(1, len(categories) + 3):
    for col in range(1, 5):
        cell = ws.cell(row=row, column=col)
        cell.border = thin_border

# Auto-adjust column widths
for col in range(1, 5):
    ws.column_dimensions[chr(64 + col)].width = 20

# Add table style
tab = Table(displayName="BudgetTable", ref="A1:D5")
style = TableStyleInfo(name="TableStyleMedium2", showFirstColumn=False, showLastColumn=False, showRowStripes=True, showColumnStripes=False)
tab.tableStyleInfo = style
ws.add_table(tab)

# Save the workbook
wb.save("/workspace/monthly_budget.xlsx")
print("Successfully created monthly_budget.xlsx")
```
